# ESN Systems (ESN)

> ESN Systems (ESN) runs ESN Hosting (Discord bot, Minecraft server, game server, VPS and web hosting, with bot hosting from $0.50/month), the ESN SMP Minecraft server (Java and Bedrock, play.esnoffical.com) with its own store, professional services for Discord and Minecraft projects, and a Discord community.

## Hosting
- Hosting overview: https://esnoffical.com/hosting/
- Plans and prices: https://esnoffical.com/hosting/vps/
- Buy a plan / sign in to the hosting panel: https://panel.esnoffical.com/plans
- Bot hosting setup (Python and Node.js): https://esnoffical.com/business/setup/
- Help center and guides: https://docs.esnoffical.com/
- Live service status: https://status.esnoffical.com/

## ESN SMP (Minecraft)
- Server IP and how to join: https://esnoffical.com/smpconnection/

- SMP store (keys, relics, bundles, premium bundles): https://esnoffical.com/storesmp/
